# Feature Quality Checklist: SLICE-05 — Chief Leader Admin-Recorded External Acceptance

**Purpose**: Formal pre-task requirements-quality gate covering lifecycle, audit, concurrency, authorization, recovery, mobile UX, accessibility, and scope boundaries
**Created**: 2026-09-23
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Business Scope and Lifecycle

- [x] CHK001 Is the allowed actor and the distinction between external confirmation and an Admin decision explicit? [Clarity, Spec §US1, FR-002–FR-004]
- [x] CHK002 Is the only allowed lifecycle transition identified as the existing Pending assignment becoming Active? [Completeness, Spec §US2, FR-005, FR-007]
- [x] CHK003 Are invalid source states and the unchanged Draft Event behavior stated consistently? [Consistency, Spec §US1–US2, FR-005, FR-008]
- [x] CHK004 Is Event-scoped operational ownership after acceptance defined without including publication behavior? [Scope, Spec §FR-008, FR-021]

## Justification and Audit Evidence

- [x] CHK005 Are meaningful, whitespace, lower-bound, upper-bound, and no-truncation requirements complete for the justification? [Completeness, Spec §US2, Edge Cases, FR-006]
- [x] CHK006 Is the required audit evidence enumerated precisely enough to establish actor, time, candidate, Event, reason, and source? [Clarity, Spec §US2, FR-010]
- [x] CHK007 Is atomic consistency between activation and mandatory audit evidence unambiguous? [Consistency, Spec §FR-011]
- [x] CHK008 Is historical preservation defined for both the assignment and immutable audit evidence? [Coverage, Spec §FR-010–FR-012]

## Authorization, Integrity, and Concurrency

- [x] CHK009 Are authentication, active Admin authorization, and server-side enforcement requirements documented? [Security, Spec §FR-001–FR-002]
- [x] CHK010 Is the same-Event Chief Leader/team-assignment exclusivity rule applied at activation? [Integrity, Spec §US2, FR-009]
- [x] CHK011 Are stale and concurrent direct-response versus Admin-response outcomes defined with one authoritative winner? [Coverage, Spec §US4, FR-013–FR-014]
- [x] CHK012 Are same-intent retry requirements distinguishable from a different or opposite committed outcome? [Clarity, Spec §US4, FR-013–FR-015]
- [x] CHK013 Are partial failure and rollback expectations stated for audit or save failure? [Recovery, Spec §US4, FR-011, FR-015]

## Interaction and Recovery

- [x] CHK014 Is the external-acceptance action required to be explicit rather than inferred from passive interactions? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003–FR-004]
- [x] CHK015 Are unfinished cancel, dirty navigation, and confirmed discard outcomes documented? [Coverage, Spec §US3, FR-016]
- [x] CHK016 Are loading, saving, overlapping-submission prevention, success, and failure states covered? [Completeness, Spec §FR-017]
- [x] CHK017 Is recoverable failure behavior specific about preserving justification and inspecting current state before retry? [Recovery, Spec §US4, FR-018]
- [x] CHK018 Are not-found, validation, authorization, invalid-state, conflict, and system-failure outcomes distinguishable and safe? [Exception Flow, Spec §FR-015]

## Mobile and Accessibility

- [x] CHK019 Are minimum viewport behavior, horizontal reflow, touch target size, labels, layout stability, and hover independence explicit? [Non-Functional, Spec §FR-019]
- [x] CHK020 Are keyboard, focus, reading order, validation association, status announcements, contrast, non-color meaning, scaling, and reduced motion covered? [Accessibility, Spec §FR-020]
- [x] CHK021 Are mobile and accessibility outcomes objectively verifiable in success criteria? [Measurability, Spec §SC-005]

## Boundaries, Dependencies, and Completion

- [x] CHK022 Are direct response, publication, replacement, staffing, inbox, delivery controls, and external integration explicitly excluded? [Scope, Spec §FR-021]
- [x] CHK023 Are dependencies on the existing Draft Event and Pending appointment documented without pulling their creation into this slice? [Dependency, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK024 Do the measurable outcomes cover success, complete audit evidence, validation boundaries, unauthorized/conflict integrity, mobile accessibility, and uncertain retry? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §SC-001–SC-006]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied.
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation.
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers.
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`.
- Items are numbered sequentially for traceable review.
